# Build: md-studio (Urgent profile)

Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): build MD Studio. It was planned but NEVER built (no branch, no log). Assigned agent: **Reel Rhonda** (book on her agent-swarm card; set AXF_AGENT=reel-rhonda if supported, else record in report + store note).

## First
- s0 Search the hub memory/notes (`/projects/_shared/_claude/notes/`, `/projects/amberx-axf/_claude/`, THREADS, store, plans/) and GitHub for any MD Studio plan/spec Brett wrote; that spec wins over this brief. Register in Urgent (id `md-studio`), banner entry.

## Build (unless his spec says otherwise)
- MD Studio = a Markdown studio plugin for the Dev Console built ON the dock engine (molly-fable #245, now on main): dockable panes for file tree, editor, live preview, outline.
- Editor with markdown toolbar (headings, bold/italic, lists, checklists, tables, code, links), live preview side by side or split, tabs for multiple docs, search/replace, autosave, version history with restore.
- **Notes section step (required):** a Notes section that opens and edits everything in the Notes Vault (`/projects/_shared/_claude/notes/` incl. sessions/, handoffs/, plans/, install/, misc/, INDEX.md) using the Notes Vault commands that landed with plugin-commands-auto; plus opening hub memory/rules files and repo .md files.
- Every command declared once so REST + MCP + CLI are generated (standing rule), so Amber can open/edit docs by voice.
- Tokens/theme only for styling; works on phone (compact window class) first.
- Tests, report `_claude/builds/reports/md-studio.md`, THREADS, PR, mark steps done through the store. Commits clean and professional.

steps.text: Plugin scaffold: plugin.json, install/uninstall, Settings > Plugins > MD Studio (level toolbar), help pack
Server: md files by scope (Project / Claude / Repo) and category, read/write, reference graph
File column: collapsible scopes + categories, search, edit switch, right-click open in horizontal/vertical split
Tab group of md files on the dock engine: floating, dockable, resizable; drop on any tab header or split
Viewer/editor: rendered markdown, edit mode, save, dirty marks, conflict-safe writes
Reference chain as branches; click a referenced name to split; split direction setting
Toolbar: 3 views + IDE view, each re-renders column, tabs and panes differently
Snippets panel: categorized, drag into the editor
Wizards for Claude md files, categorized by purpose and scope (project, Claude, repo)
Tests, check-theme/check-controls, lifecycle, UI Review shots, PR

Notes scope: a 4th scope 'Notes' in the file column showing /projects/_shared/_claude/notes with the same folders, reusing notes-browser's server route (capability axf.notes@1: list/read/write(if_version)/move/remove/history; optional, hide the scope when absent)
Context view (handoff Nov 3): open a session context md as a reference chain with token counts per part; Open context in MD Studio deep link for approval rows

Editor kit (Brett voice Nov 3): markdown toolbar (headings, bold/italic, lists, checklists, tables, code, links), live preview side-by-side/split, search/replace, autosave, version history with restore
Commands declared once (plugin-commands@1 auto: REST + MCP + CLI) so Amber can open/edit docs by voice; Notes Vault + hub memory/rules + repo .md reachable

open: "Open context in MD Studio" on approval rows (axHub approvals, console banner, AmberX) is not wired: those live in other apps. Ready for it: deep link `https://console.amberxai.com/?md-context=<id or path>` and the `open-context` command. The per-session `.context.md` files the handoff describes don't exist yet (separate build); once they do, the approval row links its path.
Repo files are saved in the console container's checkout; they are not committed by MD Studio (commit from a session or Snapshots).
Android twin: none (Android on hold; MD Studio is a console plugin, not a framework engine).

In the headless screenshot run, fetches started later in a page sometimes waited several seconds behind the console's open live streams (HTTP/1.1 connection limit of the dev server); the API itself answers in milliseconds (`/file` 6 ms, `/files` 0.3 s, `/chain` 0.2 s on the real repo + hub).
